# Draw 2D API

<div class="doc-meta"><span class="doc-badge">Reference</span> Generated from <code>src/caffeine/script/api/draw2d.json</code></div>

Immediate-mode 2D overlay shapes (lines, circles, rectangles, polylines) in world or screen space.

<!-- Generated by caffeine-website/scripts/generate-api-pages.py. Edit the engine JSON instead. -->

## Functions

### `caffeine.draw2d.beginFrame`

`beginFrame()`

Starts a new overlay frame, clearing previous draw2d shapes. Call it once at the start of drawing.

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.draw2d.beginFrame()
```

### `caffeine.draw2d.line`

`line(a, b, color[, thickness[, space]])`

Draws a line in the 2D overlay.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | table | Start {x, y}. |
| `b` | table | End {x, y}. |
| `color` | table | {r, g, b, a} in 0..1 (each defaults to 1). |
| `thickness` | number | Line thickness (default 1). |
| `space` | string | "world" (default) or "screen". |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.draw2d.line({x=0,y=0},{x=5,y=5},{r=1,g=0,b=0,a=1}, 2)
```

### `caffeine.draw2d.circle`

`circle(center, radius, color[, thickness[, space]])`

Draws a circle outline (32 segments).

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `center` | table | Center {x, y}. |
| `radius` | number | Radius. |
| `color` | table | {r, g, b, a} in 0..1 (each defaults to 1). |
| `thickness` | number | Line thickness (default 1). |
| `space` | string | "world" (default) or "screen". |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.draw2d.circle({x=0,y=0}, 3, {r=0,g=1,b=0,a=1})
```

### `caffeine.draw2d.rect`

`rect(min, max, color[, thickness[, space]])`

Draws a rectangle outline.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `min` | table | Corner {x, y}. |
| `max` | table | Opposite corner {x, y}. |
| `color` | table | {r, g, b, a} in 0..1 (each defaults to 1). |
| `thickness` | number | Line thickness (default 1). |
| `space` | string | "world" (default) or "screen". |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.draw2d.rect({x=-1,y=-1},{x=1,y=1},{r=1,g=1,b=0,a=1})
```

### `caffeine.draw2d.poly`

`poly(points, color[, closed[, thickness[, space]]])`

Draws a polyline or polygon outline.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `points` | table | Array of {x, y}; at least 2 points or nothing is drawn. |
| `color` | table | {r, g, b, a} in 0..1 (each defaults to 1). |
| `closed` | boolean | Close the shape (default false). |
| `thickness` | number | Line thickness (default 1). |
| `space` | string | "world" (default) or "screen". |

**Example**

```lua
caffeine.draw2d.poly({{x=0,y=0},{x=2,y=0},{x=1,y=2}}, {r=1,g=1,b=1,a=1}, true)
```
